generate_certificate_code.body: DECLARE alphabet CONSTANT TEXT := '23456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ'; candidate TEXT; i INT; attempts INT := 0; BEGIN LOOP candidate := ''; FOR i IN 1..12 LOOP candidate := candidate || substr(alphabet, 1 + floor(random() * length(alphabet))::int, 1); END LOOP; candidate := substr(candidate, 1, 4) || '-' || substr(candidate, 5, 4) || '-' || substr(candidate, 9, 4); EXIT WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.user_certifications WHERE certificate_code = candidate ); attempts := attempts + 1; IF attempts > 20 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Não foi possível gerar um código de certificado único'; END IF; END LOOP; RETURN candidate; END;

docs: bossReport.edgecases.test.ts: Casos-limite do relatório consolidado do Chefão. Foco em branches que a simulação aleatória raramente cobre: fronteiras exatas da janela, datas inválidas, meses vazios, virada de ano, saneamento de parâmetros e contagem de batalhas sem data.

campaignImport.simulation.test.ts: Simulacao exaustiva do motor de ingestao de resultados de campanhas. Objetivo: provar que nenhuma planilha hostil produz credito indevido, duplicidade silenciosa ou excecao nao tratada.

departmentWarConfig.simulation.test.ts: Simulacao massiva do motor de configuracao da Guerra de Departamentos. Objetivo: provar, antes de qualquer gestor tocar na tela, que nenhuma combinacao de entradas (inclusive hostis) produz configuracao que estoure a economia, quebre invariantes ou lance excecao.
edgeErrors.simulation.test.ts: Simulação exaustiva do classificador de erros de Edge Functions. Cobre ~1.000 combinações de status x corpo x header x erro local.
invokeEdgeSafe.simulation.test.ts: Simulação do backoff exponencial e da política de retry do invokeEdgeSafe.

luckyWheelPayoutHistory.simulation.test.ts: Simulação massiva da série histórica de payout da Roleta. Estratégia: gerador determinístico (LCG) produz centenas de janelas com lacunas, duplicatas, valores hostis (NaN, negativos, strings, datas inválidas) e verificamos as invariantes do motor puro.

# Task Gifts V2 — Plataforma de Gamificação Corporativa

> **Promo Brindes** · Stack: React 19 + Vite 8 + TypeScript 5.9 + Supabase + Vercel

[![CI](https://github.com/adm01-debug/Task_Gifts_V2/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/adm01-debug/Task_Gifts_V2/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

## 🚀 Produção

**URL:** https://task-gifts-v2.vercel.app

## How can I edit this code?

There are several ways of editing your application.

**Use Lovable**

Simply visit the [Lovable Project](https://lovable.dev/projects/REPLACE_WITH_PROJECT_ID) and start prompting.

Changes made via Lovable will be committed automatically to this repo.

**Use your preferred IDE**

If you want to work locally using your own IDE, you can clone this repo and push changes. Pushed changes will also be reflected in Lovable.

The only requirement is having Node.js & npm installed - [install with nvm](https://github.com/nvm-sh/nvm#installing-and-updating)

Follow these steps:

```sh
# Step 1: Clone the repository using the project's Git URL.
git clone <YOUR_GIT_URL>

# Step 2: Navigate to the project directory.
cd <YOUR_PROJECT_NAME>

# Step 3: Install the necessary dependencies.
npm i

# Step 4: Start the development server with auto-reloading and an instant preview.
npm run dev
```

**Edit a file directly in GitHub**

- Navigate to the desired file(s).
- Click the "Edit" button (pencil icon) at the top right of the file view.
- Make your changes and commit the changes.

**Use GitHub Codespaces**

- Navigate to the main page of your repository.
- Click on the "Code" button (green button) near the top right.
- Select the "Codespaces" tab.
- Click on "New codespace" to launch a new Codespace environment.
- Edit files directly within the Codespace and commit and push your changes once you're done.

## What technologies are used for this project?

This project is built with:

- Vite
- TypeScript
- React
- shadcn-ui
- Tailwind CSS

 ## 📋 Audit & Inventory
 
 Access the full enterprise audit report and system inventory:
 - [Audit Report (Markdown)](./audit_report.md)
 - [Audit Report (PDF)](./audit_report.pdf)
 - [System Inventory Detail](./SYSTEM_INVENTORY_AUDIT.md)
 
 ## How can I deploy this project?

Simply open [Lovable](https://lovable.dev/projects/REPLACE_WITH_PROJECT_ID) and click on Share -> Publish.

## Can I connect a custom domain to my Lovable project?

Yes, you can!

To connect a domain, navigate to Project > Settings > Domains and click Connect Domain.

Read more here: [Setting up a custom domain](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/custom-domain#custom-domain)
